content_blocks.title: Three Test Tubes with Foaming/Precipitate Reactions
content_blocks.content: Image shows three capped test tubes (with black screw caps) resting on a blue towel/cloth surface. All three tubes contain a white/milky liquid or suspension at the bottom. The left tube shows a white precipitate or dense foam at the bottom portion. The middle tube shows a large foam/bubble column rising from the liquid to approximately mid-tube height, suggesting active gas production or surfactant activity. The right tube shows a smaller foam layer at the top of the liquid with minimal bubbling. The differences in foam volume and bubble structure across the three tubes suggest a comparative experiment — possibly testing different concentrations, formulations, or conditions of a substance. No labels, annotations, or quantitative data are visible in the image.
